changes: Presets: keep several complete layouts and run them all at once, each on its own port (4140, 4141, …). Point each OBS scene at its own preset's URL, e.g. the full overlay while playing and chat only while talking. Nothing to switch during a stream.
New panels: Units (each player's army by unit type, largest first) and APM (actions per minute). Both start switched off, so updating does not disturb an existing OBS layout.
Hero panel now works: level, experience, learnt skills and items for each hero.

Real names and icons instead of game codes (Blademaster instead of Obla), read from your own Warcraft III install in your language, including upgrades. Works offline. Without an install, English names cover the melee units, heroes, abilities and items.
The row under each player in the match panel now shows only the economy (gold, lumber, food, workers, upgrades). Units and heroes have their own panels.
Chat: optional Twitch / YouTube icon before each name, in brand colours or in the overlay's accent colour.
Fair play still applies to the new panels: while you play, only your own slot is shown.
Army on the overlay: gold, lumber, food, workers, finished upgrades, units by type and heroes with level, skills and items, shown under each player row.
Fair play: while you play, the overlay shows only your own army. Opponents' armies and economy appear only when you are observing or watching a replay.
Observer detection: observing a game and W3Champions watch mode are recognised automatically. A new "Observing or watching replays" switch covers local replays.
Draws: games agreed with -draw are now recorded as draws instead of losses, in the daily record, match history and head-to-head. The daily panel shows them separately.
W3Champions is recognised from its launcher, so custom and AI games there are attributed to the right platform.
More reliable player name and lineup detection, especially in lobbies with many computer slots.

First release: live match / hero / item overlay from shared memory, W3Champions stats (MMR, win probability, scouting, H2H), fully configurable OBS feed, 6-minute trial + license keys, offline revocation check.
